text:
Platform lifecycle and workspace evidence

Conceptually, the platform turns an idea into explicit requirements, implementation, validation, deployment, observation, and feedback-driven revisions. In this workspace, only project identity metadata, version 1, session metadata, and an empty approved-work-product list are evidenced; no application components or running deployment can be confirmed without a workspace tree or repository contents.

End-to-end lifecycle
flowchart LR
    A[User idea] --> B[Requirements and constraints]
    B --> C[Workspace artifacts and source]
    C --> D[Build and automated validation]
    D --> E[Deploy to runtime]
    E --> F[Running application]
    F --> G[Logs metrics feedback]
    G --> H[Prioritized improvements]
    H --> B
    W[Current evidence: project metadata only] -. cannot verify .-> C
    W -. cannot verify .-> D
    W -. cannot verify .-> E
    W -. cannot verify .-> F

issues: A concrete workspace-specific lifecycle cannot be provided because no workspace tree, source files, deployment configuration, or runtime evidence is available.
The lifecycle shown is explicitly generic rather than evidence of this platform’s actual implementation.

limitations: No workspace file tree, source files, manifests, tests, infrastructure configuration, deployment records, or runtime telemetry were supplied.
A concrete inventory and platform-specific lifecycle therefore cannot be established from the available context.
